paragraphs.text: Balance Logic

runs.text: Balance Logic

paragraphs.text: When a transaction is saved, the system calculates: new balance = credit balance before + total credit quantity - total utilization.

runs.text: When a transaction is saved, the system calculates: new balance = credit balance before + total credit quantity - total utilization.

paragraphs.text: Top-up and free-credit activities increase the balance through Credit Qty.

runs.text: Top-up and free-credit activities increase the balance through Credit Qty.

paragraphs.text: Usage or loss activities reduce the balance through Total Utilization or negative credit quantity depending on the activity setup.

runs.text: Usage or loss activities reduce the balance through Total Utilization or negative credit quantity depending on the activity setup.

paragraphs.text: The saved transaction keeps both Credit Before and Credit After so the ledger can be audited later.
